title: Secret-shaped output rejection
description: abs preview where the supplied --msa-app-id is a JWT/bearer-token-shaped value. The value would flow into the report (abs.appId and the operator-supplied change targets), so the by-construction SecretMaterialGuard refuses to emit the report, failing with a generic internal error (exit 1). The error names only the offending property PATHS, never the value.
note: The --msa-app-id here is a SYNTHETIC, non-functional, JWT-shaped test vector (NOT a real token). It exists solely to exercise the redaction guard. The captured golden reports property paths only and contains no secret value.

json.errorMessage: Refusing to emit ABS provisioning report: secret material detected at abs.appId, changes[1].target, changes[2].target. ABS scaffolding output must be no-secret by default; return a secret reference instead.

stderr: Refusing to emit ABS provisioning report: secret material detected at abs.appId, changes[1].target, changes[2].target. ABS scaffolding output must be no-secret by default; return a secret reference instead.
